basics.name: Tulga-Erdene Sodjargal
basics.label: Undergraduate Researcher in ML for Molecules & Materials
basics.summary: KAIST B.S. student (Bio and Brain Engineering, double major in Chemistry) interested (broadly) in machine learning for accelerating scientific computing. Specific interest and experience in long-range corrections to ML potentials, statistical methods for molecular simulations, and scientific software development.

work.name: Puzzle AI
work.summary: Built a robust pipeline for LLM-driven single-turn dataset expansion, with automated Korean-to-English translation and I/O parsing for downstream training.

work.name: Wellman Center for Photomedicine, Harvard Medical School (Prof. Mei X. Wu)
work.summary: Established the group's computational research capability as its sole dry-lab researcher within an otherwise wet-lab team; independently designed and ran molecular-docking and simulation studies to rationalize and guide experimental results.
highlights: Tools: AutoDock Vina, NAMD, Gaussian, Bash

work.name: Laboratory of Computational Science and Modeling, EPFL (Prof. Michele Ceriotti)
work.summary: Developed machine-learning interatomic potentials that incorporate long-range interactions, improving accuracy for molecular property prediction and molecular dynamics. Co-authored a journal paper (TMLR, 2025) and presented first-author results as a poster at the DPG Spring Meeting 2025. Contributed to open-source atomistic-ML libraries and interactive Jupyter-based teaching materials, including PyTorch-level optimizations and CI/CD.
highlights: Tools: PyTorch, ASE, LAMMPS, ipywidgets, Git, Bash

work.name: SpiderCore Inc.
work.position: Research Intern (ML for Molecules) — bachelor's thesis
work.summary: Built graph neural networks for gene-therapy design, contributing domain-specific chemical expertise to model design; devised a chemically-inspired self-supervised pretraining task that lifted model performance to state-of-the-art levels.

work.name: University of Illinois Urbana–Champaign (Prof. Taras V. Pogorelov)
work.summary: Analyze all-atom molecular-dynamics trajectories of cellular membranes of differing lipid composition to support multi-team drug-design projects. Refactored the analysis pipeline, cutting runtime by more than 30× and enabling structural insights not previously tractable. Co-authoring a manuscript currently in preparation.

work.name: Department of Biological Sciences, KAIST
work.summary: Designed candidate therapeutic antibody variants using deep-learning protein-design tools (Prof. Byung-Ha Oh).

work.name: Department of Chemistry, KAIST
work.summary: Developed novel chemical reactions via combinatorial screening (Prof. Yoonsu Park).

awards.summary: Developed time-series forecasting models with cost-aware objective optimization to predict demand for electronic parts; placed 5th among 20+ teams from leading Korean universities.

awards.summary: Graph convolutional neural network for predicting hydrogen-bond basicity (pKBHX) on a ~350-molecule dataset.

projects.name: Cost-Aware Demand Forecasting for Electronic Parts
projects.summary: Time-series forecasting models with cost-aware objective optimization; Silver Award, 5th of 20+ teams at the 3rd POSTECH–UNIST–KAIST Data Science Competition.

projects.name: Predicting Hydrogen-Bond Basicity (pKBHX) on a Small Dataset
projects.summary: Graph convolutional neural network predicting hydrogen-bond basicity from molecular structure in a low-data regime (~350 molecules), using regularization and hyperparameter tuning to counter overfitting; ranked 1st among undergraduates (4th of 13 overall).

projects.name: Housing Price Prediction
projects.summary: Regression models with feature engineering, preprocessing, and hyperparameter tuning; ranked 7th of 60 in the class competition.

projects.name: Analyzing Workplace Discrimination in Korea
projects.summary: Uncovered national trends in workplace discrimination through EDA, hypothesis testing, and clustering.

projects.name: SNP Analysis of the COVID-19 Delta Variant Surge
projects.summary: Implemented a heuristic global sequence-alignment algorithm from scratch in pure Python to detect SNPs associated with the Delta variant surge in England; interpreted the biological roles of identified SNPs through targeted literature review.

projects.name: Biomedical Information System for Healthcare
projects.summary: Relational database integrating genomics and pharmacokinetics data, with a command-line interface simulating healthcare-provider use cases.
